title: spex-brick-mesh bundle manifest (mesh.json)
description:
Written by `spex-mesh` (crates/spex-mesh/src/bundle.rs): describes real LDraw geometry packed for one-time upload to WebGL — a manifest plus tightly packed little-endian binary buffers, the same shape as tileset.json + octree/*.bin. Read by the viewer's mesh render mode (M54). Absent for every point-cloud and graph tileset, which is exactly how the viewer decides which of its two render paths to take.

Two properties of this format are load-bearing and are stated in the manifest rather than assumed by readers. Positions are in MILLIMETRES with +Y up, converted once from LDraw's own LDU/Y-down frame — and because negating Y is a mirror, the writer also reverses every triangle's winding, without which backface culling is inverted for the entire library. Colours are LINEAR, not sRGB, because three.js r152+ reads them as linear and would otherwise render every material about 2.2x too bright.

unit.description: Positions and bounds are millimetres. LDraw's own unit is the LDU (0.4 mm); the conversion happens once, in spex_mesh::bundle::to_output_position.

upAxis.description: LDraw is Y-down. The conversion negates Y, which is a mirror — see the writer's own doc comment for why triangle winding is reversed with it.

colorSpace.description: Every colour in this file is linear, converted from LDConfig.ldr's sRGB values through the real piecewise transfer function. Renderers must NOT convert again.

creaseDegrees.description: Dihedral angle below which normals were averaged during welding. 30 by default: LDraw's 16-segment primitives meet at 22.5 degrees so they smooth, and a brick's corners are at 90 so they stay sharp.

partFile.description: The real LDraw part filename, e.g. "3005.dat". Parts are keyed on this ALONE and never on (part, colour) — the geometry carries no colour, which is what lets two colours of the same part share one mesh and makes instancing possible.

description.description: The part's own title, from its first `0 <description>` line.

vertexCount.description: position and normal buffers are each vertexCount * 12 bytes.

triangleCount.description: the index buffer is triangleCount * 12 bytes.

hardEdgeCount.description: real LDraw type-2 lines; the hardEdge buffer is hardEdgeCount * 24 bytes.

conditionalEdgeCount.description: real LDraw type-5 lines; the condEdge buffer is conditionalEdgeCount * 48 bytes — two endpoints followed by two control points. A conditional edge is drawn when both control points project to the SAME side of the edge.

submeshes.description: Contiguous index ranges, one per distinct colour, so a renderer binds a material once per range and never mid-buffer.

material.description: Index into materials[], or NULL meaning LDraw colour 16 ("inherit") — take the instance's own material. A number is a fixed accent colour molded into the part itself.

sources.description: Every real LDraw file that contributed geometry, in first-seen order — e.g. ["parts/3005.dat", "parts/s/3005s01.dat", "p/stud.dat"]. This is what a LOD pass gates stud and tube removal on: by real reference path, never by guessing from geometry.

license.description: The part's own `0 !LICENSE` line, carried through so a bundle states its terms rather than the build asserting them.

colorCode.description: The real LDraw colour code from LDConfig.ldr.

orientations.description: Distinct 3x3 row-major orientations, already conjugated into the output frame. An instance references one by u8 index — which is what makes a 10-byte instance record possible at all. A scene needing more than 256 fails the write rather than silently degrading.

instanceEncoding.description: Instances are BINARY, not a JSON array. At Atlas scale an instances[] array is roughly 37 MB of text, ~120 MB of parsed heap and about a second of main-thread parse before the first frame; ten bytes each is 2.5 MB.

translationUnitMm.description: 0.4 — translations are stored as i16 counts of one LDraw unit, which is exact for grid-legal geometry and gives +/- 13.1 m of addressable local extent.

maxTranslationErrorMm.description: The largest rounding error any instance actually incurred, measured at write time. Zero for grid-legal scenes. Recorded rather than assumed, so an off-grid model is visible instead of quietly approximated.

instanceIds.description: Stable ids in the same order as instances.bin, so a show's target globs resolve to instance indices once at load time rather than being re-globbed per frame.

bufferPath.description: Relative to this manifest's own directory, so a bundle can be served from a domain root or any subpath.
